profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Lockheed Martin | UX-Focused Frontend Developer | Google UX Design Certificate | Building Human-Centered Digital Experiences
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise applications and delivering reliable software solutions in complex environments.

Alongside my engineering work, I’m expanding into UX-focused frontend development through the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, strengthening skills in user research, wireframing, and prototyping using Figma.

I’m particularly interested in building intuitive, accessible digital experiences that connect strong engineering foundations with thoughtful design.

Outside of my primary role, I facilitate STEM workshops with Next IT Girl teaching AI and programming concepts to middle and high school students, helping broaden access to technology education.

Interests: Frontend Engineering • UX Engineering • Product Development • Human-Centered Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development and maintenance of software solutions for aerospace applications, ensuring compliance with strict
customer specifications.
• Led Scrum ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives), managing team progress and resolving blockers for
consistent delivery.
• Conducted white-box testing by creating comprehensive unit test cases, validating code functionality and customer requirements.
• Moderated Software Performance Engineering sessions, facilitating peer reviews to maintain code/requirements quality and best practices.
• Optimized existing codebases, enhancing performance and scalability while aligning with industry standards
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Agile Testing · Ada programming · Serena Dimensions · Version One · Scrum · Rational Apex · Debugging · Requirement tester · Rational DOORS · Computer Science · Jira

positions.title: member
positions.description: worked as a team of 5 on a final project that used Google's API to access the user's location and located the nearest hospitals, police stations and fire stations. This project allowed user's to be aware of their surroundings in case they felt unsafe as they walked down the street. There was a non-emergency section that allowed our user step by step instructions to cure a minor cut or bruise. Also step by step instructions on what to do while waiting on an ambulance depending on their needs. Our prototype allowed users to have accessibility to this information all in one area to decrease the number of sites they had to navigate through to find what they need.

projects.title: Skegee Made Scholarship Fund (web developer/UX UI designer)
projects.description: I graduated from Tuskegee University May 2020. Since graduating I wanted to give back in any way I could to my University. My inspiration to start this scholarship was COVID-19, I noticed many of my classmates and students that were coming in after me were in need.

projects.title: Safe House App (prototype)
projects.description: Safe House was an application I built while at Girls Who Code Intel. I worked on a team with four other women to complete the application. The application consisted of two parts, an informational part for taking care of cuts burns and bruises as well as a portion that used Google Maps API to pin point the users location and locate the surrounding police stations, fire departments and hospitals.
